long_biography.plain_text:
Roche Group combines property development with tourism businesses across eastern Australia. Its residential pipeline includes projects in New South Wales and Queensland, while its visitor portfolio reaches from Hunter Valley gardens and accommodation to hospitality venues and agricultural land.

The platform emerged after Bill and Imelda Roche sold their Nutrimetics cosmetics enterprise in 1997 and redirected capital into property. Dominic Michael Manson Roche belongs to the generation now directing the firm alongside Damian Roche. He held the executive-chairman role by 2020, bringing together the real-estate and visitor-economy sides of a privately held, diversified operation.
